shortBio.en: Franz Ferdinand frontman; angular guitar and danceable post-punk singles.
shortBio.zh: Franz Ferdinand 主唱；棱角吉他与可跳舞后朋克单曲。

body.en: Born 1972. Lead vocals and guitar for Franz Ferdinand. Debut (2004) puts the Glasgow guitar-dance singles on UK/US radio.
body.zh: 1972 年生。Franz Ferdinand 主唱与吉他。首专（2004）把格拉斯哥吉他舞曲单曲送进英美电台。
